_comment: The credits page (src/render/ui/creditsScreen.ts), from the menu and the Supporter page. The Founders and the Supporters come from the game server, each under the name they chose for the credits; everything here is written by hand. madeBy is who made the game: put your own name or your studio's in place of the one here. thanks is anyone else to thank, one line each - testers, friends, whoever helped. builtWith is the open-source software the game is made with, whose licences ask for nothing more than the notice in each package, and get a thank-you anyway.
sound: Every sound and piece of music was made for the game, from code in its own repository.
